name: welcome_email
subject: Welcome to {{company_name}}, {{first_name}}!
body:
Dear {{first_name}} {{last_name}},

Welcome to {{company_name}}! We are thrilled to have you join the {{department}} team as a {{job_title}}.

Your start date is {{start_date}}, and your manager will be {{manager_name}}. Please arrive at {{office_location}} by {{arrival_time}} on your first day.

Here are a few things to prepare before your first day:
- Bring a valid government-issued photo ID
- Review the pre-boarding documents sent to your personal email
- Complete any outstanding background check forms

Your onboarding buddy will be {{buddy_name}}, who will help you get settled during your first few weeks.

If you have any questions before your start date, please don't hesitate to reach out to your HR contact at {{hr_contact_email}}.

We look forward to seeing you!

Best regards,
{{hr_sender_name}}
Human Resources
{{company_name}}

name: welcome_slack
farewell_email
subject: Farewell and Best Wishes to {{first_name}} {{last_name}}
body:
Dear Team,

I am writing to let you know that {{first_name}} {{last_name}} will be leaving {{company_name}} effective {{last_day}}.

{{first_name}} has been a valued member of the {{department}} team for {{tenure}}, and we wish them all the best in their future endeavors.

Please join us for a farewell gathering on {{farewell_event_date}} at {{farewell_event_time}} in {{farewell_event_location}}.

For any ongoing projects or handover questions, please reach out to {{handover_contact_name}} ({{handover_contact_email}}).

We thank {{first_name}} for their contributions and wish them continued success.

Best regards,
{{manager_name}}
{{department}}

name: farewell_slack
body:
Hi team -- I wanted to share that *{{first_name}} {{last_name}}* will be moving on from {{company_name}}, with {{last_day}} being their last day.

{{first_name}} has been an incredible part of the {{department}} team, and we're grateful for everything they've contributed over the past {{tenure}}.

Please stop by the farewell gathering on {{farewell_event_date}} to say goodbye and wish them well! :heart:

For any project handovers, please contact {{handover_contact_name}}.

name: manager_notification_departure
subject: Employee Departure Notification: {{first_name}} {{last_name}}
body:
Dear {{manager_name}},

This is to confirm that {{first_name}} {{last_name}} ({{job_title}}, {{department}}) has submitted their resignation / been approved for departure.

Departure Details:
- Employee: {{first_name}} {{last_name}} ({{employee_id}})
- Last Working Day: {{last_day}}
- Reason: {{departure_reason}}
- Notice Period: {{notice_period}}

As their manager, please ensure the following are completed before their last day:

1. Knowledge transfer plan and documentation
2. Project handover to {{handover_contact_name}}
3. Return of all IT assets (laptop, monitor, phone, headset, badges)
4. Removal from team meetings and channels
5. Final performance notes
6. Notify clients/stakeholders as appropriate

IT asset return must be completed by {{asset_return_date}}.
Access revocation will occur automatically on {{access_revocation_date}}.

Offboarding dashboard: {{dashboard_url}}

Please reach out to {{hr_contact_name}} ({{hr_contact_email}}) if you have any questions.

Best regards,
HR Offboarding Team
